who.value: seller setting up a Live show

job.value: create the show and turn on auto-posting to connected socials

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The first screen reads as 'Create Live', but the 'Auto-post to socials' section the page explores is only reached after a long scroll.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: 'Create Live' is pinned but greyed, and the 'Connect' link for Telegram sits far down the form.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Connect', 'Ship together', 'Ship separately' and 'Create Live' predict their result.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Shipment grouping', 'Set shipment limit' and 'Waiting Screen' are unexplained until the sub-copy below them.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Most fields fit, but a 'Set shipment limit' at 'S$165' asks a combining rule a new host may not have thought through.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Deal method, shipment grouping, a limit and meet-up info all show expanded in full before the auto-post section.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Labels carry most fields, but the shipment-limit callout and 'Auto-post to socials' explainer are multi-line prose.
